calculate_trip_cost.name: Calculate trip cost
calculate_trip_cost.description: Estimate the fuel cost of a trip from its distance and the vehicle's consumption.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Sends one type of fuel price notification now, with the current prices. The target's language, fuels, priority and tap target apply; whether the type is switched on and presence are ignored.

not_configured.message: LëtzFuel HA is not set up yet.

stale_data.title: Fuel prices are out of date
stale_data.description: The newest published price is {age_days} days old. The source may have stopped publishing or has changed. Check the price page and the integration logs.

parse_error.title: Cannot read the fuel price source
parse_error.description: The price page was reached but could not be parsed ({error}). The page layout may have changed. Please open an issue.

announcements_unavailable.title: Tomorrow's price is only shown late
announcements_unavailable.description: For {days} days the announcement feed for tomorrow's price could not be used, so a backup is used instead. If that fails too, tomorrow's price only appears once the official price table lists it, usually late in the evening. Check the diagnostics and please open an issue if this persists.

confirm.title: Turn off the blueprint automation
confirm.description:
LëtzFuel HA now sends the notifications itself (Settings > Devices and services > LëtzFuel HA > Notification). The automation {automations} uses the notifications blueprint and sends the same notifications again, so every notification arrives twice.

For the standard notifications this automation is no longer needed. Keep it only for your own actions or texts, and switch off the types you now get from the integration. Otherwise turn it off here, or delete it under Settings > Automations and scenes.

Submit to turn off {automations}.
